# Guitar Pro parser fixtures

Unmodified binary test scores from alphaTab 1.8.4, encoded as base64 in `scores.json`.
Source commit: https://github.com/coderline/alphaTab/tree/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/test-data

Keys are exact upstream paths below test-data. These small artificial scores exercise legacy GP3–GP6 and GP7/GP8 timing and percussion.
